messages:
Sam: Heads up — my feature branch feature/gc-optim is failing CI after I merged main yesterday. Tests in tests/kv_cache_test.cpp are red.

Sam: CI job: https://ci.redwood.internal/teams/eng/jobs/3421 (logs attached)

ci-bot: Job 3421 failed on unit-linux-16 — error: assertion 'cache_size == expected' at kv_cache_test.cpp:87

Jess: Can you paste the failing assertion and the stack? small snippets ok.

Sam: Here's the assertion and a tiny backtrace:
```
[ RUN      ] KVCacheTest.MemoryPressure
../tests/kv_cache_test.cpp:87: Failure
Expected: cache_size == expected
  Actual: 512 vs 256
#0 0x7f.. in run_test
#1 0x7f.. in main
```

Chen: Did you merge main or rebase? There was a serialization change last night that touches cache sizing.

Sam: I merged main into my branch (not rebased) — merge commit 9f3a2b1 from main. Repro locally with:
```
git checkout feature/gc-optim
git pull origin main
bazel test //tests:kv_cache_test --test_arg=--runslow
```

Ryan: I can bisect if you want. Start with last green on main? What's the last green job id?

Sam: Last green on main was job 3418, commit a1b2c3d. After merge, 3421 failed.

Ryan: I'll try a quick git bisect locally to find the offending commit. If it's the serialization change, we need to either adjust the test expectation or make the serialization backward-compatible.

Jess: Can someone trigger a CI rerun on that job (might be a flaky failure)? If it's deterministic after the merge we'll fix it, otherwise a rerun helps.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by @Jess for job 3421. New run: 3430 — https://ci.redwood.internal/teams/eng/jobs/3430

Sam: Thanks. I'll also try a temp revert of my merge locally to check.

Ryan: Quick update — bisect points to commit 7b4e9f (main) which changed KVCache::serialize() layout. That explains size mismatch. I can open a PR to update tests and add an adapter for old layout. @Sam, can you rebase on main tip after that PR or we can fix on top of your branch.

Sam: Please open the PR and ping me. If it's a small test change to expected size, go ahead and land with a short note in changelog.

Maria: FYI, add a note to the release checklist — breaking change in serialization should be communicated to downstream teams.

Jess: I'll wait for Ryan's PR and then re-run CI on Sam's feature after he rebases. If it's still failing we can revert the merge commit temporarily.

Sam: Sounds good. PR link when ready, and thanks everyone.
